definition: a style that suddenly everyone follows
description: Two friends walk through a European old town and realize with growing shock that everyone around them wears the same yellow bucket hat - cyclists, cafe guests, grandmas, even a passing corgi. The boy gives in, grabs a yellow hat from a street stand and proudly puts it on while his friend facepalms.
transcript: Everyone has one! And now me too!
